reason: Provides a lazy MCP proxy that exposes discovery and invocation of configured external MCP server tools while caching their catalog to reduce prompt context usage.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的惰性 MCP 代理，通过两个工具按需发现并调用已配置 MCP 服务器中的工具。
summaries.en: A lazy MCP proxy for DeepSeek Harness that discovers and invokes tools from configured MCP servers through two fixed tools.

capabilities: Discovers tools from configured MCP servers
Invokes tools on configured MCP servers with passed arguments
Connects to configured streamable HTTP MCP endpoints
Reads and writes a persistent tool catalog cache
Discovers tools from configured MCP servers
Invokes tools on configured MCP servers with passed arguments
Connects to configured streamable HTTP MCP endpoints
Reads and writes a persistent tool catalog cache
